Subject: Billing readiness sweep: PO timing and invoice queues

Hi team,

Quick sweep before we close the books for the October cutover. I want to confirm PO timing and any invoicing dependencies that could block bookings recognition for Acme Health. Please reply with the status on the items below by EOD today: 

- PO receipt: do we have a signed PO on file? if not, estimated issue date.
- Invoice window: earliest invoice date vs. contract start date (any proration needed?).
- Billing contact and delivery method (email, portal, EDI).
- Any procurement constraints (net terms, remit-to changes, PO number formatting).

I've attached the latest commit matrix and flagged the lines where Acme is in the October commit window. If we don't have PO in-hand by Oct 7 we may need to delay recognition to the November batch — need to be explicit to Finance.

Related link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c_commit_matrix

Thanks — Soojin

Soojin — quick update below and attaching what I have.

- PO receipt: Procurement at Acme sent a draft PO yesterday; they expect the final signed PO by 2027-10-07. I have the draft here (ACME_PO_7892.pdf).
- Invoice window: Contract start = 2027-10-01. They want first invoice on 2027-10-15 (mid-period) and then monthly thereafter. Finance prefers month-start invoices; will need to confirm if proration is acceptable.
- Billing contact: billing@acmehealth.com. They requested invoices be sent to that mailbox and uploaded to their vendor portal as a backup.
- Constraints: They require PO number in the invoice reference and their payment terms are Net45.

Attachment stubs: ACME_PO_7892.pdf (pdf), redwood_commit_matrix_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

If procurement actually signs on 10/07 we can keep Acme in the October recognition bucket assuming Finance approves proration policy. Marcus — can you confirm the proration rule application and whether Net45 affects recognition date?

Thanks,
Vanessa
